text:
Tara (Marketing): Finalizing plans for next Tues webinar 'Real-world Inference: demos + economics'. Need to lock: one-sentence abstracts, 2 rehearsal windows, fallback clip, and a simple post-webinar funnel.

Leo (Growth): Landing page copy A/B ready. Will run technical vs outcome-led headlines. Will push variant at 10am tomorrow.

Aiden (Product): Speakers confirmed: me, Tom (eng), and a customer (Nora). I'll own the benchmark one-pager and include testbed details (seq len, batch shape, GPU).

Rina (Design): I'll make a 3-slide teaser + 30s hero clip. Need headshots + 1-line bios by EOD.

Noelle (SDR): Handoff rules: tag by poll response + time-attended. MQL if attended >= 20min OR clicked book-office-hours. Route high-intent to #sdr-live.

Tara (Marketing): Rehearsal slots: Mon 16:00 or Tue 09:00. Which works?

Tom (Eng): Tue 09:00 works. I'll prepare a 60s prerecorded fallback showing the demo flow and the batching config. Paste snippet in the doc.

Tom (Eng): ```bash
# batching snippet
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 24
  max_latency_ms: 20
```

Leo (Growth): Metrics to track: recording views (1/7/30d), follow-up CTR, demo bookings, cohort MQL rate. I'll wire up a small dashboard.

Aiden (Product): For the benchmark narrative: include uncertainty ranges and a short caveat line. Don't put raw $ figures until we validate.

Tara (Marketing): Post-webinar plan: 1) recording + clip share, 2) segmented follow-up email (engineer vs procurement), 3) 1-click survey at close. I'll draft emails by Fri.

Noelle (SDR): I'll prepare templates for the first 48h outreach and the 7-day nurture. Tag me when leads are routed.

ops-bot: Webhook /sales/handoff verified. Recording auto-upload enabled.

Tara (Marketing): Owners: Decks & assets = Rina; Benchmark one-pager = Aiden; Fallback clip + demo script = Tom; Growth analytics = Leo; Lead handoff = Noelle. Rehearsal Tue 09:00. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
